notes: The source page is the Computer Science Associate of Science Degree page. It prints no section for the Computer Science Certificate of Achievement, which appears only as a link in the site menu. No certificate requirements were recorded.

The A.S. section lists the following required courses, totaling 33 units: CIT 100, CS 077, CS 100, CS 102 or CS 102H, CS 104, CS 110, CS 120, CS 220, and CS 190 or CS 215. It also recommends CS 160. A reviewer should fetch the certificate's own page (computer-science-certificate-of-achievement) to confirm the certificate's requirements.
CS 215 and CS 160 appear in the A.S. section but are not in the closed list.

The page's program learning outcomes and its career statement ('entry-level positions as programmers for scientific and business applications') belong to the A.S. degree. They were not recorded for the certificate.
